intro.title: Every celebration, a crafted narrative.
intro.description: From first look to final farewell, House of Dipali designs the full arc of your wedding weekend - blending timeless tradition with refined, modern styling. Every stage, every bloom, and every detail is considered as part of one continuous story.

services.title: A full-service approach to wedding decor and design for every celebration.

services.title: Centerpieces

image.alt: Centerpieces

services.summary: For couples across Long Island, NYC, and New Jersey, House of Dipali designs centerpieces and tablescapes built around every event…
paragraphs: For couples across Long Island, NYC, and New Jersey, House of Dipali designs centerpieces and tablescapes built around every event of your wedding weekend, from ceremony to reception. Whether your celebration calls for low, floating, or tall arrangements, every design is shaped by your venue and color story, using premium materials like brass, crystal, and mirrored accents. Never a one-size-fits-all package.

services.summary: Your mandap is the heart of the ceremony. House of Dipali designs custom mandap structures and ceremony decor for South…
paragraphs: Your mandap is the heart of the ceremony. House of Dipali designs custom mandap structures and ceremony decor for South Asian weddings across Long Island, NYC, and Manhattan — from traditional carved-wood mandaps to modern, floral-forward designs. Whether your ceremony is Hindu, Sikh, Muslim, or multicultural, every space is built around your traditions, your colors, and your venue.

events.title: Abhi & Sravya Wedding Celebration

image.alt: Featured Image – Abhi & Sravya Wedding Celebration – House of Dipali

events.venue: Leonard’s Palazzo · Crest Hollow Country Club · The Rockleigh
paragraphs: A glimpse into our wedding weekend with Sravya & Abhi. Each celebration was intentionally designed with its own distinct color palette, design language, and atmosphere, ensuring guests experienced something entirely new with every event. While each venue—from Crest Hollow to Leonard’s and The Rockleigh—offered its own timeless beauty, our vision was to layer in thoughtful details and elevated design that transformed every space into a celebration uniquely reflective of our couple.

image.alt: Featured Image – Kevin and Sanika’s Engagement Ceremony – House of Dipali

paragraphs: The wedding festivities began with a beautifully curated engagement celebration. Inspired by the elegance of spring, we brought the couple’s vision to life with an enchanting cherry blossom design, creating the perfect setting for their April celebration.

events.title: Zoha’s Reception

image.alt: Featured Image – Zoha’s Reception – House of Dipali

paragraphs: Our beautiful bride, Zoha, envisioned décor that was effortless yet intentional. From a cozy Mehendi celebration in a charming barn setting to an elegant candlelit reception designed to complement the golden chandeliers of The Venetian, every detail was thoughtfully curated to bring her vision to life.

events.title: Anjana & Nirav’s Wedding Celebration

image.alt: Featured Image – Anjana & Nirav’s Wedding Celebration – House of Dipali

paragraphs: Anjana envisioned a Sangeet immersed in lush greenery, with a true jungle-inspired aesthetic filled with towering trees. While bringing that vision to life inside the Hyatt initially felt like a challenge, thoughtful planning and creative design transformed the space beautifully. Paired with her vibrant sunflower-inspired Haldi, an intricately crafted floral mandap, and a contemporary LED backdrop, each celebration reflected a unique expression of her vision.

reviews.quote: Working with House of Dipali for our decor needs was one of the best decisions I made throughout our wedding. Simran is an absolute gem and was so easy to work with to bring our ideas to life. I gave her a bit of information and she ran miles with it to make our vision come to life. I also didn't have to constantly check in with her about numerous things because she was on it and I was able to trust her. Simran and her team were punctual, prompt, and a clear communicator which is a must for all type A brides and their timelines! I could not recommend House of Dipali enough, book them!!!
reviews.name: Karal

reviews.quote: Simran and Nitin at House of Dipali did a fantastic job with my wedding mandap setup and evening backdrop display! They were very easy to work with throughout the process as well
reviews.name: Valli

reviews.quote: Simran and Nithin were approachable, knowledgeable, and helpful in every aspect of our big day. Our decor looked beautiful on the day of and many of our guests told us later on how much they admired the fresh flower arrangements. One moment in particular stood out to me: we ordered a special boutonniere for the groom and were informed that it was out of stock very close to the day of the wedding. However, on the day itself, Nitin went out to Queens early in the morning and arrived back on LI at our venue right on time with a beautiful lily. The effort they put in was truly worth recommending.
reviews.name: Daniel

reviews.quote: We used House of Dipali for our entire wedding weekend including our haldi, sangeet, wedding and reception and could not have been happier with the service! Simran was great from the beginning with scheduling time and meetings to go over vision boards, help tweak items to fit our budget and make our overall vision come to life. We really appreciated her honesty when it came to helping us figure out ways to cut extra costs to stay within our budget but still getting the overall look we wanted for each event. Simran and her team were very professional, hard working and talented. We will definitely use house of dipali for any future events and definitely recommend to all!
reviews.name: Nisha

reviews.quote: We hired House of Dipali for our multi-event wedding at Aqua Turf in Connecticut, and they did an incredible job! Managing multiple events is no easy task, but they executed every single look perfectly. Each event had its own unique, stunning vibe, and our guests couldn't stop raving about the decor. The team was professional, highly organized, best time management and completely stress-free to work with. They truly brought our vision to life—we cannot recommend them enough!
reviews.name: Vaishna

reviews.quote: My husband and I had such a wonderful experience working with Simran for our wedding in July 2026! From the very beginning, she was incredibly attentive, accommodating, and truly took the time to understand our vision. She made time to sit down with us and go over all of the design details, which made the entire process feel so personal and stress-free. Everything came together beautifully on our wedding day, and the flowers were absolutely stunning! Simran brought our vision to life even better than we imagined. We are so grateful for all of her hard work, creativity, and attention to detail. We would highly recommend House of Dipali to anyone looking for a talented and caring florist for their special day!
reviews.name: Sabrina

reviews.quote: We cannot say enough amazing things about House of Dipali! They truly brought every single one of our wedding visions to life, and somehow made each event feel completely unique while exceeding what we had imagined. Our Haldi had the most beautiful Amalfi Coast-inspired vibe — bright, fresh, fun, and absolutely perfect for the celebration. For our Sangeet, they completely transformed the space with vibrant, colorful décor that brought so much energy to the night. Our outdoor wedding ceremony was breathtaking. The coral, red, and blush tones were romantic, elegant, and stunning against the outdoor setting, and the full mandap was an absolute showstopper. Then, for our reception, they completely changed the atmosphere again. We wanted an over-the-top, elegant all-white look with evergreens, and they delivered beyond our expectations. Walking into the reception felt magical. What impressed us most was that no two events looked or felt the same. We had four completely different visions, and House of Dipali understood every one of them. From the colors and florals to the overall atmosphere and smallest details, everything felt intentional and true to what we wanted. Seeing each space for the first time was such a special part of our wedding weekend. House of Dipali took our ideas and elevated them into something even more beautiful than we could have envisioned. We received so many compliments from our guests, and looking back at our photos, we’re still amazed by how incredible everything looked. Thank you to the entire House of Dipali team for making every event feel so special and for creating the perfect backdrop to some of our favorite memories. We would recommend them over and over again!
reviews.name: Shamini & Harsh

reviews.quote: We worked with Simran and Nitin for the decor of our Hindu ceremony in New Hope, PA, and truly cannot say enough wonderful things about House of Dipali. From the very beginning, we appreciated their open communication, collaborative approach, and willingness to brainstorm creative solutions that worked within the unique confines of our ceremony space. One of the highlights of our venue was a beautiful willow tree that we really wanted to incorporate into the overall aesthetic. Simran and Nitin understood our vision and brought it to life beautifully, executing everything flawlessly. The result was even more beautiful than we could have imagined. In addition to the décor, House of Dipali provided the fresh florals for our aisle and reception tables, our garlands, bridal bouquet, and extra petals. Every detail was thoughtfully executed and added so much beauty to our wedding. We would wholeheartedly recommend House of Dipali to anyone looking for an incredibly collaborative decor and floral team.
reviews.name: Zahra

reviews.quote: We had a wonderful experience working with Simran from House of Dipali. She is thoughtful in her approach and worked with us and our budget to deliver on our vision for the decor. We loved how the decor turned out and several guests complimented it too! Beyond her creativity and ability to create beautiful backdrops, what makes Simran unique is that she cares for your WHOLE event - as we got to know each other, she helped us find other vendors too (at least one of whom we went with!) and followed up with us after the event to ensure we had a positive experience with her recommendations. Would highly recommend this team!
reviews.name: Ami

reviews.quote: House of Dipali was amazing to work with for our Haldi and Wedding day. Simran took all of our ideas and made them a reality (even better than we imagined)!
reviews.name: Aleesha

reviews.quote: We hired House of Dipali for our engagement party & had an unforgettable experience! We had a set vision for how we wanted the stage to look, and they delivered on our “Under The Cherry Blossom” theme to perfection. We couldn’t be any happier with how it all turned out! Highly recommend Nitin & Simran for all your decor needs
reviews.name: Kevin

reviews.quote: This team made our wedding absolutely breathtaking!!! The stage setting was stunning, the floral arrangements were gorgeous, and the table settings were styled to perfection. They went above and beyond in every way. We are so grateful and would recommend them to anyone without hesitation! Simran is very easy to talk to and she was able to understand our vision and execute it perfectly!! Thank you

reviews.quote: I was referred by one of my colleagues to them, from the moment I made that call Simran took everything upon herself to help you visualized your perfect wedding, she worked with you no matter what budget is, my wedding was so fairytale like and all because of this place that made everything possible, I Strongly recommend this place for your upcoming event or Wedding you will not disappoint.

reviews.quote: House of Dipali made my wedding dreams come true. I worked with them for all of my wedding events. From our first day planning decor to the actual event the communication was excellent. All of the inspo pics we discussed were brought to life in the exact way I wanted. Such a friendly and accommodating team and I’d trust them over and over again for more family events in the future. Thank you so much for everything, it was beyond amazing.
reviews.name: Zoha

reviews.quote: House of Dipali did outstanding decor for my wedding reception at Leonard’s Palazzo. Everyone was so impressed by its elegance and charm. Thank you Simran, Nitin, and the entire team who helped my reception come to life!!
reviews.name: Tiffany

reviews.quote: We worked with Simran and House of Dipali for decor across several events this past year, including a holiday celebration, a first birthday, and a mayon ceremony at our home--as well as a wedding reception at The Rockleigh. Across all of these events, Simran brought thoughtful ideas and a great eye for design that helped make each occasion feel special and memorable. For the home events, she created decor that really matched the tone of each celebration and accentuated our home perfectly. The holiday setup felt festive and vibrant, the first birthday was playful yet elegant, and the mayon ceremony decor was out of this world. Simran always had creative suggestions while still incorporating our preferences and keeping within our budget. For the wedding reception, the final result truly exceeded our expectations. The stage design, florals, centerpieces, and candle arrangements came together beautifully and created an incredible focal point in the room. We challenged her repeatedly with a unique vision, and she went the extra mile to try to meet it. Importantly, she not only matched the inspiration photos we sent her, but took it up a notch to ensure it felt refined and elevated in the space without feeling overdone or tacky. Many of our guests commented on how stunning the space looked. Simran and her team clearly put a lot of effort into the setup and execution, and the final outcome reflected the vision we had discussed. We’re grateful for the creativity and care she brought to all of our celebrations this year, and we would absolutely recommend House of Dipali to anyone looking for beautiful, impactful luxury event decor.
reviews.name: Abdullah

reviews.quote: House of Dipali worked magic for all of our events. They provided services for our Sangeet Night, Ceremony, and Reception. My husband and I could not be happier with the results. Sangeet Night was a pop of color with gold accents that made everything feel lively and fun! Our Ceremony was minimal and elegant which brought to life the feeling of shared love. And our Reception really knocked it out of the park. The theme was fairytale and Disney. Being the Disney enthusiast that I am, I had a vision which was brought to life by the team at House of Dipali. I wanted subtle Disney princess centerpieces. I didn’t want it to explicitly say “Cinderella” or “Aurora.” But instead, a clock that was striking midnight and a glass slipper, or a spindle with pops of blue and pink. The House of Dipali team took this vision and ran with it. I had 10 princess centerpieces with another 12 regular centerpieces. Everything was a masterpiece and it made for a fun game with the guests to “Guess the Princess.” It was perfect. Thank you to the House of Dipali team and thank you Simran for going with my crazy idea! Sangeet Photos - Marcus Lewis Photography Ceremony and Reception Photos - William Thomas Photography

The floral arch and centerpieces were exactly what I wanted, and the ceremony space, cocktail hour area, and reception room were set up perfectly. about.title: Beginning
paragraphs: House of Dipali began as a small family store offering pooja essentials, handcrafted garlands, statues, and diyas - giving our brand its name and its foundation.

As our passion for creating meaningful celebrations grew, so did our vision. What started with intimate home and backyard weddings gradually evolved into designing and producing celebrations of every scale across the Tri-State area.

What means the most to us, however, is the relationships we've built along the way. Many of the families who once visited our store for a small statue, a garland, or pooja essentials now return years later to trust us with their weddings, their children's celebrations, and life's most meaningful milestones. Being part of those memories across generations is a privilege we never take for granted, and it continues to inspire everything we create.

image.alt: House of Dipali wedding decor process - step 1: Beginning

about.title: Process
paragraphs: Our process begins with a quick inquiry through our contact form, where you'll share a few key details about your celebration, such as your event date, venue, guest count, and vision. This helps us prepare before we connect with you. If you prefer, you're always welcome to give us a call to schedule a consultation.

Your consultation is completely complimentary and takes place with one of our lead designers. During this meeting, we'll get to know your style, discuss your event requirements, and explore your ideas in detail. From there, we'll create a personalized proposal with a thoughtfully curated design plan and transparent pricing tailored to your celebration.

image.alt: House of Dipali wedding decor process - step 2: Process

about.title: Our Expertise
paragraphs: At House of Dipali, our expertise goes beyond creating beautiful décor - it's about designing a celebration that feels uniquely yours.

Every event begins with understanding your vision, priorities, and the experience you want your guests to have. From there, we thoughtfully design a concept that makes the most of our extensive inventory, incorporating custom elements only when they truly add value. Through creative styling, intentional color palettes, and carefully selected details, we ensure every celebration feels distinctive and never like a repeat of the last.

We also believe great design should work hand in hand with your budget. Whether that means incorporating silk florals instead of fresh blooms, reimagining décor elements, or helping you decide which features will have the greatest impact, we guide you through every decision with honesty and transparency. Our goal is to help you invest where it matters most while creating a celebration you'll love.

Most importantly, we believe your décor should tell your story. No two couples or celebrations are the same, which is why we encourage every client to schedule a consultation with our design team. It's an opportunity for us to get to know you, understand what matters most, and create a celebration that feels personal, intentional, and unmistakably yours.

image.alt: House of Dipali wedding decor process - step 3: Our Expertise

about.title: Execution & Logistics
paragraphs: Once your design is finalized, our team begins bringing every detail to life behind the scenes. From sourcing materials and ordering fresh florals to coordinating production schedules, every step is carefully planned to ensure your celebration comes together exactly as envisioned.

We work closely with your venue to confirm measurements, access times, installation requirements, and logistics well in advance. By anticipating the details before event day, we're able to create a seamless installation process and avoid last-minute surprises.

If you're working with a wedding planner or day-of coordinator, we're happy to collaborate with them throughout the planning process. Open communication between every vendor allows us to create a smooth experience - not just for you, but for everyone involved in bringing your celebration to life.
On the day of your event, our focus is simple: to handle every detail with precision and care so you can be fully present, knowing your vision is in experienced hands.

image.alt: House of Dipali wedding decor process - step 4: Execution & Logistics

about.title: A Partnership Beyond Design
paragraphs: Creating a memorable celebration takes more than beautiful décor—it takes a team of trusted professionals working together behind the scenes.

Over the years, we have built relationships with talented vendors who share our commitment to quality and attention to detail. From custom stationery and print details to floor wraps, entertainment, photography, and more, we are always happy to connect you with professionals who can help bring your overall vision to life.

When you step into a consultation with House of Dipali, our goal is to provide more than just décor ideas. We want you to leave feeling more confident, more informed, and with a clearer vision for your celebration. Whether it's answering planning questions, offering recommendations, or helping you navigate decisions beyond our scope, we are always here to support you throughout the journey.

image.alt: House of Dipali wedding decor process - step 5: A Partnership Beyond Design

values.title: Cultural Fluency
values.description: Deep experience across the full South Asian wedding-weekend arc - sangeet, mehndi, haldi, ceremony, and reception.

values.title: Editorial Craftsmanship
values.description: Every installation is designed to be as beautiful in person as it is in photography.

values.title: Trusted Venue Relationships
values.description: Established partnerships with the region's most celebrated wedding venues.

faqs.question: Can you work with our venue and other event vendors?
answer: Of course. Collaboration is an important part of creating a seamless celebration. We regularly coordinate with venues, planners, photographers, and other vendors to ensure every design detail and timeline comes together beautifully.

faqs.question: Do you travel for events outside New York and New Jersey?
answer: Yes. While many of our celebrations take place throughout New York, New Jersey, and surrounding areas, we are open to destination and travel-based events depending on the scope and logistics. Please contact us to discuss your location and event details.

faqs.question: What is your design and planning process like?
answer: Our process begins with a consultation where we learn about your celebration, preferences, and vision. From there, we develop a customized design concept, refine details together, and carefully coordinate every element leading up to the event. On the day of your celebration, our team manages execution so you can enjoy the moment with peace of mind.

faqs.question: Do you offer fully customized decor and event design?
answer: Absolutely. Every House of Dipali celebration is uniquely designed and tailored to reflect your story, vision, and style. From floral artistry and décor elements to color palettes and atmosphere, we create thoughtful experiences that feel personal and memorable.

faqs.question: How far in advance should we book House of Dipali?
answer: We recommend reaching out as early as possible, especially for peak wedding and celebration seasons. Most clients begin the design process several months in advance to allow time for consultation, planning, sourcing, and thoughtful design development. However, depending on availability and scope, we are happy to discuss shorter timelines as well.

referralSource: Saw Your Decor at an Event
